data.body:
Connecta
FeaturesDiscoverPlus
Sign inOpen Connecta
1,284 people hanging out right now

Hang out somewhere cosy.

Connecta is a little 3D place for your friends. Make a room, share a link, and walk over to whoever you want to talk to.

Make your room Try a room as a guest

Free · no download · friends join from a link

🍅 Mai · focusing 25m
“come sit with us!”
6 in the Library

Chat apps are where you talk. Connecta is where you hang out.

🚶

Walk over

Voice gets louder as you get closer. Wander off to start a side chat.

🛋️

Just be there

Sit on the sofa with your mic off. Your friends still see you.

🎴

Do something

Cards, videos, drawing, quizzes. In the room, together.

Walk up to talk

Conversations happen like they do in real life

Walk up to someone and their voice fades in. Three friends by the window, two at the desk: little groups, one room, nobody talking over each other.

🐰Mai🐱you🐻Jod🦊Ploy🐼Ken🔊 You hear Mai and Jod

Things to do together

Never just staring at each other

Every room has a big screen, a card table, an art corner and more. Walk up, press E, and you’re playing. Call everyone in with one button.

📺Watch together
🃏Card games
🐺Werewolf
🗳️Pick a Side
✏️Draw & Guess
🎨Whiteboard
🐱Pet the cats
🤖Study buddies

Study, if you want

A study room that doesn’t feel lonely

A Pomodoro over your head, a to-do list, lo-fi music, and a weekly ranking with your friends. Quiet rooms keep the games away.

🍅 Pomodoro · Calculus

18:42

🏆 This week with friends

🥇 Nam 13h 40m

🥈 Mai 11h 30m

🥉 you 8h 20m

Your room, your people

A room that’s there when you’re not

Make a room for your friends or your class. Its chat keeps going when nobody is inside, even from your phone. Dress up your chibi and pick a cosy map.

🍓Chanom Friends 3 inside · Cosy LibraryWalk in
MMailibrary at 8? the cat is here 🐱
JJodomw, bringing snacks

No friends online yet?

Walk into a Common room

Rooms run by Connecta that anyone can walk into. Text only, so they’re comfy with strangers.

See them all
📚LibraryQuiet study 142 here🐈Cat CaféChill and chat 57 here🌙Starry RooftopLate-night talks 3 here

Cosy means safe

Private by default

Your room is invite-only until you open it.

Friends-only messages

Strangers can’t DM you. Ever.

Report anything

People, messages, pictures, rooms. A real team reads them.

13+ and moderated

Rude-word filter, picture checks, and mods in every room.

Connecta Plus

Free for friends. Cuter with Plus.

Everything above is free for up to 25 at once. Plus makes your rooms fit 100, unlocks premium maps, skins and pets, and your whole room enjoys it. Only the owner pays.

฿89 a month

See what you get

Questions

Is it free?

Yes. Rooms, voice, chat and every activity are free, for up to 25 people at once. Plus (฿89 a month) makes your rooms bigger and dresses you up.

Do I need to download anything?

No. Connecta runs in your browser, on a laptop or a phone. Friends join from a link.

Can my friends join without an account?

Yes, as guests, in rooms whose owner allows it, and in Common rooms. They pick a name and a look and walk in.

Who can talk to me?

Only your friends can message you. Rooms are private unless the owner opens them, and you can report or block anyone.

How old do I need to be?

13 or older.

🛋️

Your friends are one link away

Make a room in a minute. Pick a map, give it a name, send the link.

Make your room

You’re on Plus · Monthly

Bigger rooms
for your people.
Cuter you.

Rooms, voice and chat stay free for everyone. Plus makes the rooms you run bigger and nicer for everyone inside, and dresses you up.

🐾 pets100 people✨ feifei

What you get

Your whole room feels it

Rooms for 100

Your rooms fit 100 at once on Big maps, and 1,000 members. Everyone inside gets it, only you pay.

Free
Plus

Premium maps

New places for your room as they arrive, Big versions of every map.

🌿🥐🍊🏖️

Skins & pets

Premium outfits and a pet that follows you around.

🐱🧥🎀

1080p sharing

Sharp slides and code when you share your screen.

720p → 1080p

Animated name tag

A shimmering name above your head and a banner on your profile.

✨ feifei

30 AI decks a day

Turn your notes into Pick a Side questions for the whole room.

🧠 × 30

Bigger uploads

Pictures and files up to 50 MB in chats.

📎 50 MB

Plans

Your plan

Monthlyyour plan

฿89 a month

Billed every month

  • Everything in Plus
  • Your rooms grow for everyone inside
  • Cancel any time
2 months free

Yearly

฿890 a year

≈ ฿74 a month, billed once a year

  • Everything in Plus
  • Your rooms grow for everyone inside
  • Pay once, done for the year
Switch to Yearly

Card: renews by itself PromptPay: we send a QR before each renewal

🎁

Gift Plus to whoever runs your room

1, 3 or 12 months, with a note. It adds on top of any Plus they already have.

Questions

Good to know

Do my friends need Plus too?

No. A room follows its owner’s plan: if you have Plus, everyone inside your rooms gets the space and the maps. Friends can chip in by gifting you Plus.

Can I pay with PromptPay?

Yes, for both plans. A card renews by itself. With PromptPay we send you a new QR in your Inbox and email 3 days before the date; if you don’t pay, Plus simply ends.

What happens to my rooms if Plus ends?

Nothing is deleted. Your rooms keep their space for 7 more days, then go back to 25 people at once, and a Big or premium map switches to its basic version while everyone stays inside.

Can I cancel?

Any time, in Settings → Plus & billing. You keep Plus until the end of what you paid for.

Refunds?

If something went wrong (charged twice, a bug), reply to your receipt email and the team will sort it out.

✓ Never pay to win✓ No ads in rooms✓ Joining a room is always free✓ Cancel any time

Demo: in the real app this page is Stripe’s hosted payment page. Nothing is charged here.

Back to ConnectaConnecta

Connecta Plus · Yearly

฿890 a year

Renews by reminder: 3 days before the date you get a new QR in your Inbox and email. Don’t pay and Plus just ends.

Scan with any Thai bank app · ฿890

The page moves on by itself once the bank confirms.

Card details go to Stripe, never to Connecta

data.body:
Connecta team

Overview Reports7 Users Rooms Common rooms Money Moderation Maps Audit log Back to Connecta

Common rooms

Run by Connecta · anyone welcome · text only

📚 Library

142 here · 8 copies open (demo shows 2)

  • Copy #120/25
  • Copy #26/25

🐈 Cat Café

57 here · 3 copies open (demo shows 2)

  • Copy #117/25
  • Copy #211/25

🌙 Starry Rooftop

3 here · 1 copies open (demo shows 1)

  • Copy #13/25

How full a copy gets

Walk in places strangers until a copy has 20, so the last 5 seats stay free for people joining a friend. A copy never holds more than 25. A new copy opens when every copy has 20; empty copies close.

Rules (fixed for every Common room)

  • Text only, no voice
  • No pictures
  • No watch together
  • No screen share
  • No Werewolf
  • Slow mode 3 s
  • Links not clickable

5 reports in 30 min from different accounts puts someone out of Common rooms for 1 hour (Moderation).

Notice in every Common room

A banner at the top for everyone inside, e.g. maintenance or an event.

Connecta team

Overview Reports7 Users Rooms Common rooms Money Moderation Maps Audit log Back to Connecta

Moderation

Every message and picture goes through these layers, in this order.

Automatic steps from reports

  • In any room: 3 reports in 10 min → muted 15 min, and flagged here.
  • In Common rooms: 5 reports in 30 min from different accounts → out of Common rooms for 1 hour, and flagged here.

Nothing else is automatic: warnings, suspensions and bans are always a person’s call.

Our word list

On top of the standard list. Matches are hidden as ••• for everyone.

Zones

New CC0 packs are added by a developer (models checked for licence and size); then they show up here.

Standard kit2 missing

  • Study spotsThe bar, a window bar and café tables12 / 12 seats
  • LoungeBeanbags by the cat tower1 placed
  • Private zonesBooths by the window1 / 2 zones
  • Big screenTV on the wallnone
  • Card tableTwo card tables, a Werewolf circle1 placed
  • Open floorThe paw-print dance floor in front of the bar16 m² (12+)
  • WhiteboardMenu board1 placed
  • Buddy MachineBuddy Machine by the till1 placed
  • Nap spotsCat beds and the cat tower2 placed
  • Spawn pointShop door with a bellplaced

Every map gets every piece, so every activity works anywhere.

Versions

  • v2 live2026-11-05 · More cat beds
  • v1 2026-10-28 · First version

Ideas for later

  • 🌿 Greenhouse · Plants, glass roof, a watering-can lamp
  • 🥐 Bakery Kitchen · Flour-dusted counters, oven glow, bread on the shelves
  • 🍊 Kotatsu House · Japanese house, kotatsu tables, snow outside
  • 🏖️ Beach Hut · Wooden deck, waves, hammocks
  • 🚀 Space Station · Round windows on Earth, floating plants
